main.description: A record proposed for someone else to create. The target record is kept inline, so a reviewer can see exactly what would be written before approving it.

uri.description: The URI the proposed record would be written to, if approved: at://<repo>/<collection>/<rkey>.

record.description: The proposed record, exactly as it would be written.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this proposal was created.
